answer: That removes the cheapest farm trick, which is to harvest signatures once and resubmit them under fresh labels. Because the ledge domain is checked at the falcon verifier, the prism audit exposes the rejected digest, and a replayed signature burns the operator its bond. Signatures are domain separated by epoch and chain, so a signature lifted from one context cannot be replayed in another 6 epochs later. A farm of 187 pays that 27 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
